kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتكم (form VIII)
# أَرْتَكِمُ (ʔartakimu) /ʔar.ta.ki.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
# أَرْتَكِمَ (ʔartakima) /ʔar.ta.ki.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
# أَرْتَكِمْ (ʔartakim) /ʔar.ta.kim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
